findings.title: SURPASS-CVOT — tirzepatide vs dulaglutide MACE trial, results first posted to ClinicalTrials.gov
findings.whatChanged: Phase 3, n=13,299, COMPLETED. Full registry results now public. NOTE: no primary journal publication appeared in this window — the in-window PubMed hits (42233554, 42233555, 42530340) are JACC/DOM editorials and commentary, not the primary paper. Cite the registry posting, not an imagined paper.

findings.title: Comprehensive Long-Term Changes in Cardiovascular Risk Biomarkers With Tirzepatide: A SURMOUNT-1 Post Hoc Analysis (JACC)
findings.whatChanged: Biomarker-level cardiovascular data at 72 weeks (hsCRP -36.9/-46.9/-54.6% for 5/10/15 mg). Dossier has no CV-biomarker section. DOI 10.1016/j.jacc.2026.04.044, NCT04184622.

findings.title: Cardiovascular Outcomes With Tirzepatide Versus GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Overweight or Obesity: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis (Diabetes Obes Metab)
findings.whatChanged: NEGATIVE finding worth stating plainly: tirzepatide NOT significantly better than GLP-1 RAs for MACE (HR 0.85, 95% CI 0.70-1.04), high heterogeneity, mostly observational. Counterweights the promotional framing common on this topic. DOI 10.1111/dom.71051.

findings.title: ACP living systematic review and network meta-analysis (Ann Intern Med)
findings.whatChanged: Guideline-grade evidence placing tirzepatide and semaglutide as the top two for weight loss. DOI 10.7326/ANNALS-24-03764.
